title: Access VLAN Assign
lesson: Access ports belong to one VLAN. Moving a host means changing the switchport access VLAN — not inventing a new cable type. Verify with show-style thinking: port VLAN must match the server's expected segment.
brief: SERVER-07 expects VLAN 20. Gi1/0/6 is still VLAN 10. Set Gi1/0/6 to VLAN 20, patch SERVER-07 there, and confirm the copper link is up.
constraints: Change the switch access VLAN (do not change the server)
